summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing a UK Regulatory News Service announcement dated 17 September 2026, disclosing transactions by persons discharging managerial responsibilities under the EU/UK Market Abuse Regulation (the US-equivalent Form 4 insider report). Four PDMRs — Kate Cheetham, Sharon Doherty, Stephen Shelley and Jasjyot Singh — acquired ordinary shares of 10p each via dividend reinvestment following the Group's interim 2026 dividend paid 15 September 2026. Prices were approximately GBP1.0997 to GBP1.108054 per share on the London Stock Exchange. These are routine, non-discretionary share acquisitions; no special-situation event, terms, board recommendation or advisor applies.
